hadiths.arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
hadiths.english: The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended.

hadiths.arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
hadiths.english: A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands the Muslims are safe.

hadiths.arabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
hadiths.english: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.

hadiths.arabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
hadiths.english: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

hadiths.arabic: بُنِيَ الإِسْلاَمُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ وَحَجِّ الْبَيْتِ
hadiths.english: Islam is built on five pillars: testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing prayer, paying Zakat, fasting Ramadan, and performing Hajj.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
hadiths.english: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ
hadiths.english: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should be generous to his guest.

hadiths.arabic: الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ
hadiths.english: The religion is sincerity and sincere advice.

hadiths.arabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ
hadiths.english: Cleanliness is half of faith.

hadiths.arabic: الْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ
hadiths.english: A good word is charity.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
hadiths.english: Whoever takes a path in search of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him the path to Paradise.

hadiths.arabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
hadiths.english: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity.

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى أَجْسَامِكُمْ وَلاَ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ
hadiths.english: Allah does not look at your bodies nor your appearances, but He looks at your hearts.

hadiths.arabic: لَا تَحَاسَدُوا وَلَا تَنَاجَشُوا وَلَا تَبَاغَضُوا وَلَا تَدَابَرُوا
hadiths.english: Do not envy one another, do not inflate prices for one another, do not hate one another, and do not turn away from one another.

hadiths.arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ كَالْبُنْيَانِ يَشُدُّ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا
hadiths.english: The believer to the believer is like a building, each part supporting the other.

hadiths.arabic: مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَوَادِّهِمْ وَتَرَاحُمِهِمْ وَتَعَاطُفِهِمْ مَثَلُ الْجَسَدِ
hadiths.english: The example of the believers in their mutual love, mercy, and compassion is like that of one body.

hadiths.arabic: ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
hadiths.english: Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.

hadiths.arabic: الدُّنْيَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤْمِنِ وَجَنَّةُ الْكَافِرِ
hadiths.english: The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.

hadiths.arabic: مَا مَلأَ آدَمِيٌّ وِعَاءً شَرًّا مِنْ بَطْنٍ
hadiths.english: No human being has ever filled a vessel worse than his stomach.

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ مِنْ أَحَبِّكُمْ إِلَيَّ وَأَقْرَبِكُمْ مِنِّي مَجْلِسًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَحَاسِنُكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
hadiths.english: The most beloved of you to me and the nearest to me on the Day of Resurrection are those of you with the best character.

hadiths.arabic: لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ
hadiths.english: He who has an atom's weight of arrogance in his heart will not enter Paradise.

hadiths.arabic: الإِحْسَانُ أَنْ تَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّكَ تَرَاهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ تَرَاهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَرَاكَ
hadiths.english: Ihsan is to worship Allah as if you see Him, and if you cannot see Him, then He indeed sees you.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
hadiths.english: Whoever relieves a believer of a difficulty in this world, Allah will relieve him of a difficulty on the Day of Judgment.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرَ صَلَوَاتٍ
hadiths.english: Whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah will send blessings upon him tenfold.

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الإِحْسَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
hadiths.english: Indeed, Allah has prescribed excellence in all things.

hadiths.arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ لاَ يَظْلِمُهُ وَلاَ يَخْذُلُهُ وَلاَ يَحْقِرُهُ
hadiths.english: A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim. He does not oppress him, forsake him, or despise him.

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ طَيِّبٌ لاَ يَقْبَلُ إِلاَّ طَيِّبًا
hadiths.english: Allah is good and accepts only what is good.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ غَشَّنَا فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا
hadiths.english: He who cheats us is not one of us.

hadiths.arabic: لاَ تَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا وَلاَ تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا
hadiths.english: You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another.

hadiths.arabic: أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
hadiths.english: The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small.

hadiths.arabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ
hadiths.english: Charity does not decrease wealth.

hadiths.arabic: الصَّلَوَاتُ الْخَمْسُ وَالْجُمُعَةُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ كَفَّارَاتٌ لِمَا بَيْنَهُنَّ
hadiths.english: The five daily prayers and from one Friday prayer to the next are an expiation for whatever sins come between them.

hadiths.arabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهِ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
hadiths.english: Fear Allah wherever you are, follow up a bad deed with a good one and it will wipe it out, and behave well towards people.

hadiths.arabic: الْقُرْآنُ حُجَّةٌ لَكَ أَوْ عَلَيْكَ
hadiths.english: The Quran is a proof for you or against you.

hadiths.arabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
hadiths.english: When a person dies, his deeds come to an end except for three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who prays for him.

hadiths.arabic: لاَ تَزُولُ قَدَمَا عَبْدٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يُسْأَلَ عَنْ عُمُرِهِ فِيمَا أَفْنَاهُ
hadiths.english: The feet of the son of Adam will not move on the Day of Judgment until he is asked about his age and how he spent it.

hadiths.arabic: اغْتَنِمْ خَمْسًا قَبْلَ خَمْسٍ شَبَابَكَ قَبْلَ هَرَمِكَ
hadiths.english: Take advantage of five before five: your youth before old age, your health before sickness, your wealth before poverty, your free time before busyness, and your life before death.

hadiths.arabic: خَيْرُ النَّاسِ أَنْفَعُهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ
hadiths.english: The best of people are those who are most beneficial to people.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمِ النَّاسَ لاَ يَرْحَمْهُ اللَّهُ
hadiths.english: He who does not show mercy to people, Allah will not show mercy to him.

hadiths.arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ
hadiths.english: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, while there is good in both.

hadiths.arabic: مَا أَكَلَ أَحَدٌ طَعَامًا قَطُّ خَيْرًا مِنْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ
hadiths.english: No one has ever eaten any food better than what he earns with the work of his own hands.

hadiths.arabic: طَلَبُ الْعِلْمِ فَرِيضَةٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ
hadiths.english: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.

hadiths.arabic: أَكْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا
hadiths.english: The most complete of the believers in faith is the one with the best character.

hadiths.arabic: الْحَيَاءُ شُعْبَةٌ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ
hadiths.english: Modesty is a branch of faith.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلاَمِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لاَ يَعْنِيهِ
hadiths.english: Part of the perfection of a person's Islam is his leaving that which does not concern him.

hadiths.arabic: الصَّلاَةُ عِمَادُ الدِّينِ
hadiths.english: Prayer is the pillar of the religion.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ أَحْدَثَ فِي أَمْرِنَا هَذَا مَا لَيْسَ مِنْهُ فَهُوَ رَدٌّ
hadiths.english: Whoever introduces anything into this matter of ours that is not from it will have it rejected.

hadiths.arabic: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْؤُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
hadiths.english: Each of you is a shepherd and each of you is responsible for his flock.

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
hadiths.english: Allah loves that when one of you does something, he does it with excellence.

hadiths.arabic: الدُّعَاءُ هُوَ الْعِبَادَةُ
hadiths.english: Supplication (Du'a) is the essence of worship.

hadiths.arabic: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ
hadiths.english: The strong man is not the one who wrestles, but the one who controls himself at the time of anger.

hadiths.arabic: لاَ ضَرَرَ وَلاَ ضِرَارَ
hadiths.english: There should be neither harming nor reciprocating harm.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ
hadiths.english: Whoever fasts Ramadan out of faith and seeking reward, his previous sins will be forgiven.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ قَامَ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ
hadiths.english: Whoever stands in prayer on the Night of Decree out of faith and seeking reward, his previous sins will be forgiven.

hadiths.arabic: سَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا وَأَبْشِرُوا
hadiths.english: Do good deeds properly, sincerely and moderately, and be optimistic.

hadiths.arabic: حُبِّبَ إِلَيَّ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا النِّسَاءُ وَالطِّيبُ وَجُعِلَتْ قُرَّةُ عَيْنِي فِي الصَّلاَةِ
hadiths.english: From the things of this world, women and perfume have been made dear to me, and the coolness of my eyes has been made in prayer.

hadiths.arabic: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَسْجُدُ لِلَّهِ سَجْدَةً إِلاَّ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةً
hadiths.english: No servant prostrates to Allah except that Allah raises him by it a degree.

hadiths.arabic: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ
hadiths.english: The closest a servant is to his Lord is when he is in prostration, so increase your supplications.

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَمِيلٌ يُحِبُّ الْجَمَالَ
hadiths.english: Indeed, Allah is beautiful and He loves beauty.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ قَرَأَ حَرْفًا مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَلَهُ بِهِ حَسَنَةٌ وَالْحَسَنَةُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا
hadiths.english: Whoever recites a letter from the Book of Allah will receive a good deed, and a good deed is multiplied tenfold.

hadiths.arabic: إِذَا سَأَلْتَ فَاسْأَلِ اللَّهَ وَإِذَا اسْتَعَنْتَ فَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ
hadiths.english: If you ask, ask Allah. If you seek help, seek help from Allah.

hadiths.arabic: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ
hadiths.english: Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler.

hadiths.arabic: اسْتَحْيُوا مِنَ اللَّهِ حَقَّ الْحَيَاءِ
hadiths.english: Be shy before Allah as is His due.

collections.name: Sunan Ibn Majah
collections.compiler: Imam Muhammad ibn Yazid ibn Majah

hadiths.arabic: أَحَبُّ النَّاسِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَنْفَعُهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ
hadiths.english: The most beloved people to Allah are those who are most beneficial to people.

hadiths.arabic: زِينَةُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الْوَرَعُ
hadiths.english: The adornment of the believer is piety.

hadiths.arabic: لاَ يَشْكُرُ اللَّهَ مَنْ لاَ يَشْكُرُ النَّاسَ
hadiths.english: He who does not thank people has not thanked Allah.

hadiths.arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْلَفُ وَيُؤْلَفُ وَلاَ خَيْرَ فِيمَنْ لاَ يَأْلَفُ وَلاَ يُؤْلَفُ
hadiths.english: The believer is friendly and befriended, and there is no goodness in one who is neither friendly nor befriended.

hadiths.arabic: كَفَى بِالْمَرْءِ إِثْمًا أَنْ يُحَدِّثَ بِكُلِّ مَا سَمِعَ
hadiths.english: It is enough of a sin for a person to narrate everything he hears.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ أَصْبَحَ مِنْكُمْ آمِنًا فِي سِرْبِهِ مُعَافًى فِي جَسَدِهِ عِنْدَهُ قُوتُ يَوْمِهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا حِيزَتْ لَهُ الدُّنْيَا
hadiths.english: Whoever among you wakes up in the morning secure in his dwelling, healthy in his body, and has his food for the day, it is as if the whole world has been gathered for him.

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلاَتُهُ
hadiths.english: The first thing a person will be held accountable for on the Day of Judgment from his deeds is his prayer.

hadiths.arabic: أَفْضَلُ الذِّكْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَفْضَلُ الدُّعَاءِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
hadiths.english: The best of dhikr is La ilaha illallah, and the best of supplication is Alhamdulillah.
